steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.title: Build the feet: tubes into foot brackets, then end caps
steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.text: Insert the front and rear 330 mm foot tubes 30 mm into each Foot bracket FB6.3, then push a v2 end cap 20 mm onto each free end. 280 mm of each tube stays exposed. No glue.

steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.title: Seat the lower square in the feet
steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.text: Build each square exactly like the single gate (optional M3 inserts in the lower corners of the lowest square, beams, vertical tubes, LED strip, DF6 diffusers); each square is wired on its own. Lower the lowest square vertically so both Corner CR6.5 dovetails reach the Foot bracket FB6.3 groove floor; the bump catches in the corner pocket. Catch and release are not physically tested.

steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.title: Optional M3 locking screws
steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.text: Optionally fit two M3 screws from the outside of each Foot bracket FB6.3 into the upper inserts of the lowest square. Screws are symbolic.

steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.title: Stack square 2 on top (illustrative, no connector)
steps-stacked2-330-v1.json.text: Set square 2 vertically onto square 1: its lower corners rest on the upper corners of the square below. ILLUSTRATIVE: no existing part locates or locks two squares together, and the stack is not mechanically connected or tested.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Fit optional Ruthex inserts into lower corners
steps-axial-v2.json.text: If M3 locking is wanted, heat-set three M3S inserts into the outside pilot holes of each lower corner before building the frame. Insert dimensions are symbolic here.

steps-axial-v2.json.title: Build upper and lower horizontal beam assemblies
